exercises.why: **должность** — office, post, appointment, position. Source: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**должность** — должность: office, post, appointment, position. Wiktionary: до́лжный + -ость.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

**бе́дность** — poverty, poorness. Source: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**бедности** — бе́дность: poverty, poorness; indigence, penury. Wiktionary: бе́дный + -ость.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).

peculiarity, feature, characteristic (important or main item)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: жи́вость — vivacity, liveliness, animation, vividness, alacrity, sprightliness; осо́бенность — peculiarity, feature, characteristic (important or main item); необходи́мость — necessity, need; не́жность — tenderness, caress, fondness, delicacy.

**осо́бенность** — peculiarity, feature, characteristic (important or main item). Source: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**особенность** — осо́бенность: peculiarity, feature, characteristic (important or main item). Wiktionary: осо́бенный + -ость.
